row: Shelter to Home Animal Foster and Adoption HK

Welcome to Shelter to Home Hong Kong – a channel dedicated to helping rescued dogs find loving homes. 🐾

We work closely with local shelters and fosters to share real stories of adoptable dogs, peaceful moments, and inspiring journeys. From adoption day highlights to relaxing puppy nap videos, every clip is made with heart.

🎥 What you’ll find here:

Relaxing dog sleep videos with calming music

Behind-the-scenes of foster life and adoption events

Life with rescue dogs — hiking, bonding, silly moments, and more

💛 Support us by subscribing and sharing.
Together, we can help more dogs go from shelter to home.

📍 Based in Hong Kong  |  📸 IG: []  |  🌐
